title: Viva Engage: Community Agent drafts and posts answers in communities
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, preview licensing, controls and documented limitations are supported. Two minor corrections remain: cite the SharePoint permissions source for site owners and remove the checklist's sensitivity-label check, which has no controls-table row.
